description: Code, experiment scripts, result artifacts, and transparency materials (append-only project log with pre-registrations, adversarial-program charter, stirring log, trap register) for the study How far do simple baselines go in CRISPRi enhancer–gene prediction? A calibrated reference class, the specificity wall, and the failure of sequence-model counterfactuals. Includes leakage-safe chromosome-holdout splitting with halo deconfliction, the distance+ATAC gradient-boosting backbone with split-conformal intervals, the Enformer ISD powered replication (negative), and the adversarial robustness program.
